subject.title: [Bug]: Slack provider doesn't reliably reload after channels.slack.botToken rotation (cached singleAuthorization)

question: Should this stay blocked on a current-main or newest-release Sandpaw/container or Control UI reproduction before any fix PR is queued?
rationale: Current source and a direct-edit run support the normal restart path, but the user-visible failure depends on an unproven environment/write boundary and automation cannot safely choose the right layer without proof.

options.title: Wait For Targeted Reproduction
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the container/Control UI diagnostics listed in the latest maintainer comment before queueing a fix.

options.title: Proactively Harden Watcher Health
options.body: Choose watcher/container hardening now, accepting that it may miss a config.patch-specific failure if that was the actual cause.

options.title: Force Restart After Slack Config Saves
options.body: Add an explicit Slack restart after Control UI/config RPC saves, accepting a broader operator-visible restart behavior without proving the watcher failed.

recommendation.title: Wait For Targeted Reproduction
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require the container/Control UI diagnostics listed in the latest maintainer comment before queueing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, already asked for the missing proof, and has the strongest combined Slack/gateway reload ownership signal.
